machine.note: rented cloud box (Selectel-class, 128GB); 64GB box OOM-killed setup (72GB peak > 64)

zkey_setup.note: ONE-TIME per circuit (trusted setup) — CAPEX, not per draw. Single-threaded read phase + parallel key-build phase (~16 cores). Needs >=128GB RAM.

prove_snarkjs.note: baseline (JS/WASM) — slow + heavy; NOT the per-draw tool

prove_rapidsnark.note: THE PER-DRAW number — native C++, ~10x faster and ~4x lighter than snarkjs

verdict.per_draw: rapidsnark prove = 39s + 11.3GB RSS => a modest 16GB box does one draw in <1 min. Plus the by-design VDF delay + cheap on-chain Groth16 verify (~200k CU).
verdict.one_time_setup: 2h47m + 72GB RSS on 16 vCPU => needs a 128GB box once per circuit; not repeated per draw.
verdict.tooling: use rapidsnark for proving (snarkjs prove is 10x slower/4x heavier).
verdict.optimization_lever: Shamir multi-exp (~7.3M) would ~halve setup time/RAM and per-draw cost.
verdict.cross_machine: constraint count 14,487,811 reproduced identically on laptop (18GB) and this 128GB box.
